item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po gser gyi yang zhun las zhal gdams gser gyis 'phreng ba
item.coloph: sprul sku tshe dbang rgyal po la/ tshe spungs gsang ba'i gter nas gdan drangs pa'o/ brag dkar dben pa'i gnas su shog ser phab pa'i yi ge pa ni/ ya nga bon po g.yung drung rgyal po (pos) bgyis pa yin/ g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa dar ba dang / sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog shog ser bu la zhal bshus pa yin/ dge ba rnam mkhyen sku gsum thob par shog/
